system_description.narrative_title: Global liquid-fuels stress: supply bottlenecks, geopolitics and price shock
system_description.narrative_summary: News cluster around a single narrative: a global liquid-fuels system under stress as geopolitical shocks (Middle East conflict, attacks on pipelines), infrastructure chokepoints (refineries, tankers, pipelines), and depleted reserves combine with shifting production and re-engagement of stranded producers (e.g., Venezuela) to drive high diesel prices and economic strain. Viewed as an open socio-technical-economic system, it exchanges physical flows (crude, diesel, bunkers), information (prices, diplomatic signals), finance (trade, reserves, investments) and policy actions across borders; inputs (production, storage, shipping capacity, diplomacy) produce outputs (prices, rationing, investment shifts, political responses) with feedbacks through markets and strategic policy measures.
system_description.scope: Global liquid-fuels market and supply chain: crude production and export decisions, refining and conversion capacity, pipelines and tanker shipping, storage and strategic petroleum reserves, major producing firms and national oil companies, fuel trading and pricing, downstream demand sectors (transport, agriculture, industry), and policy/diplomatic actions affecting flows.
system_description.super_system: Global geopolitical-economic system (international trade, finance, security and energy diplomacy)
adjacent_subsystems: Shipping & Maritime Logistics (tankers, chokepoints such as Hormuz)
Geopolitical Security & Diplomacy (Middle East conflict, Venezuela negotiations)
Commodity Finance & Markets (futures, traders, asset flows)

variables.name: Crude production rate
variables.description: Rate of crude oil extraction and initial supply made available to markets per unit time.

variables.name: Crude export flow
variables.description: Volume of crude oil crossing borders and loaded for international export per unit time.

variables.name: Refinery throughput rate
variables.description: Rate at which refineries receive feedstock and process it into refined liquid products.

variables.name: Refining conversion capacity
variables.description: Installed physical capacity to convert crude input into refined liquid fuels (maximum processing capability).

variables.name: Pipeline transit flow rate
variables.description: Volume per unit time transported through pipeline networks between production, storage and refineries.

variables.name: Tanker shipping availability
variables.description: Effective available tanker fleet and charter capacity able to carry crude and refined products internationally.

variables.name: Fuel storage inventory level
variables.description: Aggregate volume of commercial and terminal storage holding crude and refined products at a point in time.

variables.name: Strategic reserve level
variables.description: Volume of government-held strategic petroleum reserves available for release or drawdown.

variables.name: Liquid fuel price level
variables.description: Market price level for key refined fuels (e.g., diesel, gasoline, marine bunkers) as observed by market participants.

variables.name: Freight rate level
variables.description: Cost level for shipping liquid fuels (tanker freight and charter rates) that influences transport economics.

variables.name: Aggregate fuel demand rate
variables.description: Total consumption rate of liquid fuels across all end‑use sectors per unit time.

variables.name: Sectoral demand distribution
variables.description: Relative allocation and dynamic shifts of fuel consumption among transport, industrial, agricultural and marine sectors.

variables.name: Infrastructure disruption rate
variables.description: Rate and intensity of unplanned outages, attacks or maintenance events that reduce pipeline, refinery or shipping operations.

variables.name: Investment flow into capacity
variables.description: Rate of financial investment directed toward upstream production, refining, storage and shipping capacity expansion or repair.

variables.name: Policy restriction intensity
variables.description: Degree and scope of trade measures, export controls, subsidies and regulatory interventions affecting fuel production and flows.

variables.name: Geopolitical tension intensity
variables.description: Overall level of geopolitical conflict, sanctions and diplomatic strain that influences cross‑border energy flows and risks.

catalysts.title: Venezuela re-engagement and investment
catalysts.description: Deals and delegations (TotalEnergies, Halliburton, Venezuelan debt talks) likely unlock financing and technical ties, enabling increased production and exports over months.
catalysts.rationale: TotalEnergies deal, Halliburton pacts and Venezuelan delegation seeking debt/energy deals could restore output and investment.

catalysts.title: Aramco halts October deliveries after pipeline attack
catalysts.description: Reported suspension of October crude deliveries to some European refiners following a pipeline attack will cut export flow and disrupt transit in October.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Aramco halts October crude deliveries to some European refiners after pipeline attack.'

catalysts.title: Aramco boosts Gulf exports in Sep–Oct
catalysts.description: Reported plan to raise Gulf export shipments in September and October may briefly ease market tightness and reduce price pressure.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Aramco to boost Gulf exports to 60 million barrels in September, October, traders say.'

catalysts.title: Persistent tanker shortage and high shipping rates
catalysts.description: Ongoing tanker scarcity and soaring charter rates constrain international shipments, prolong transport bottlenecks and raise costs.
catalysts.rationale: Multiple headlines: 'Tanker Shortage Sends Oil-Shipping Rates Soaring' and 'A Shortage of Oil Tankers...'

catalysts.title: Costly Hormuz shuttles continue
catalysts.description: Shuttling vessels through the Strait of Hormuz keeps flows but at elevated operational and security cost, sustaining higher freight and insurance premiums.
catalysts.rationale: Commentary/headlines: 'Hormuz shuttles keep oil flowing, but at a high cost' and 'Vessels trickle through Strait of Hormuz.'

catalysts.title: Political push to ban US diesel exports before midterms
catalysts.description: Calls from politicians to ban diesel exports ahead of US midterms could create export restrictions and alter domestic supply/prices if enacted.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'top Republicans tell Donald Trump to ban US diesel exports ahead of midterms.'

catalysts.title: Diesel shortage extending into 2027
catalysts.description: Reports that global diesel deficits and drained storage tanks will likely persist into 2027, sustaining price pressure and drawdowns.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Global diesel shortage likely to last into 2027 as storage tanks drain.'

catalysts.title: Europe Q4 jet-fuel supply deficit
catalysts.description: Forecasted Q4 jet fuel shortfall in Europe will strain refinery allocations and inventories, pushing up jet and related fuel prices seasonally.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Europe faces Q4 jet fuel supply deficit even as South Korea becomes latest big supplier.'

catalysts.title: Refinery chokepoints remain primary constraint
catalysts.description: Widespread reporting that refineries are main chokepoints implies constrained throughput, outages and limited ability to convert crude to products.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Refineries Are Now the Main Chokepoint for Global Energy Supplies.'

catalysts.title: Pressure to act on US Strategic Petroleum Reserve
catalysts.description: Record-low US SPR levels increase political and market pressure for policy responses (releases or swaps), creating potential short-term market moves.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Oil stocks in US strategic petroleum reserve fall to lowest level since 1982.'

catalysts.title: Chevron drilling spree and capacity investment
catalysts.description: Chevron's announced drilling expansion will increase upstream investment flows and, over time, add to production capacity.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Chevron plans drilling spree as it overhauls oil and gas search.'
